newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Earnings hopes push Danubius to new high.
newsitem.headline: Earnings hopes push Danubius to new high.

text.p: Shares in Hungarian hotel company Danubius Rt surged to a new high of 5,570 forints on Tuesday on hopes of good earnings reports for 1996, but these record price levels triggered profit-taking, traders said.
Danubius opened at 5,250 forints, little above Monday's end of 5,240. Turnover was light with only a few thousand shares traded.
"I think these prices reflect investors' expectations of the company's annual results," one trader said, adding that the company has a good track record of confirming expectations.
The trader said foreigners began to buy the paper and later domestic clients joined them. Sellers became more willing to unload their Danubius stocks at around 5,500 forints, he said.
"Profit-taking is quite heavy at these levels."
Hungarian bourse-listed companies have to publish their preliminary 1996 annual results by February 15 and with two exceptions, all companies are still ahead of the procedure.
